All default off; the recipe below is unchanged (the ab/mc 138 tokens). BEFORE: ab/mc (2026-11-14, wave 3 of the ablation round, sub-agent U): BENCH branch of the search loop's two new generic pieces - auto_spine.py --mc-envs (a no-cull Monte Carlo stage, October's beam_tas --elite-frac 1.0 --keys-temp 1.5, after the tree and before the archives) and train_fast --auto-spine-archive-bar (an archive line whose curriculum failed bars later archive lines). Owner abmc runs offline benches on the all-in's saved unitfarmer2 weights (abuf2_all, md5 60b665bf); no training run is launched from this branch. The recipe below = the all-in (137 tokens) with the Monte Carlo stage in --a
goal: Does the recipe that finishes sidistic, cannonball and petrus also finish surf_unitfarmer2 from the true start, champion-free, with no flag or constant changed? unitfarmer2 is the project's exploration benchmark (CLAUDE.md section 0): its start is a dive into a pit that raises the goal distance by about 2,840 u before anything pays, the same class of unpaid stretch the recipe failed on at princessburglar's pit and blue200's void. Read by greedy finishes from the true start inside the finish trigger's CLIP HULL (the trigger is three 1 u curtains, not a box; the core and score.py test the hull) and the step of the first finishing eval; without a finish, by where the greedy policy stops and whether it leaves the pit. The training win rate is never read alone: only with the reservoir's minimum depth. References, bars to read against and never constants: September's eight champion-free arms, 1B steps each, never passed the pit; October's control (sidistic's then recipe, from scratch) 5.6% and 0/9; October's agent-built lineage (pit-specific treatments, a tick ramp, hand-cut lines: not one recipe) had the greedy out of the pit at 2.94B steps and its first real 9/9 at 15.02B, best 34.54 s on the game clock; the human record is 35.15 s.
_field_doc: surf_unitfarmer2's goal graph WITHOUT corner cutting at lidar cell 32, the field the recipe shapes on (--race-no-corner-cut 1). All caches (goal_32, goalc_32, occ_32, slabocc_32, sdf_32, faceid_32) were baked on 2026-10-30 by the smoke launch uf2op_bake on a box, on a core that already loads every brush entity (6bd7f931), and are deployed from ~/ar_m2/maps/uf2_maps.tar.gz (md5 84e7daa0, a copy of ~/ar_uf2/maps/uf2_maps.tar.gz; goalc_32 md5 bfd4e79b, bsp md5 9834c24c). The field builder is unchanged for a single-box zone since that bake (the only change, 2026-10-31, adds a signature suffix for zones of several boxes), so the box bakes nothing. goalc_32: 6.84M voxels, reach_max 34,596 u; the field is seeded from the finish trigger's bounding box while the finish itself is tested on the clip hull.
_score_episodes_doc: score.py counts only the first N episodes of an eval (header episode index < N): its score is a max over episodes, so an eval with more episodes would buy lottery tickets (r6b1 scored 98.418 with 54-episode evals of the incumbent's weights). 0 = all.
_rounds_doc: The user, 2026-11-10 11:31 UTC, on the one-search series: 'I think we can call it. Let's wrap it up, and then start the methods that did converge on other map. E.g. princessburglar'. No orchestrator runs here; round_hours / rounds are unused.
_max_boxes_doc: Ablation round: the droplet watchdog caps the fleet at five boxes.
_budget_end_hours_doc: Hours from this program's start (state.json started) over which box.py spreads the credit above the reserve: ~$11.5 above the $10 reserve at the start = two fast boxes for about 14 h. No top-ups by the operator.
_gpu_tiers_doc: UNITFARMER2 (2026-11-11): the general tiers, unchanged from petrus. surf_unitfarmer2's 32 u grid is 256 x 257 x 104 = 6.84M voxels (petrus 8.8M, cannonball 671M), so any card of the list fits; October's unitfarmer2 program ran on 16 GB RTX 4080 / 5080 cards.
_max_dph_doc: $/h for the WHOLE box, its disk_gb of storage included: box.py prices offers with --storage disk_gb, and the fleet watchdog checks the instance's dph_total against its own caps (this table is a subset of them). FAST cards first in this program, because a 26 h round is read in steps: measured on the recipe last round, RTX 5080 368k steps/s, RTX 4080 282k, RTX 3090 215k, RTX 5060 Ti 125-179k (the host CPU is half of it). So tier 0 is the 5080 class, then the 3090s, then two 16 GB fallbacks, then a 4090 or 5090 at its old cap; the 4070 / 3080 / 5060 class of 2026-10-25 is out (10B steps in 20 h would not reach the late walls). Caps sit just above the market of 2026-11-09 (5080 0.28-0.31, 4080S 0.41, 3090 0.29-0.36): a 5080 at 0.59 is double the going rate and is not rented (CLAUDE.md: never rent above the market price).
offer_query: num_gpus=1 cuda_vers>=12.8 reliability>0.98 inet_down>300 rentable=true disk_space>60 cpu_cores_effective>=32 cpu_ghz>=2.5 verified=true gpu_ram>=12
_cpu_exclude_doc: Regexes on the offer's cpu_name. vast's cpu_ghz is the TURBO clock (a Haswell E5-2696 v3 lists 3.8 GHz), so it does not catch old server parts: box 56818837, a 3090 on dual Xeon E5-2699 v3 (72 threads, Haswell 2014), trained the incumbent recipe at 57-59k steps/s with the trainer at 5,400% CPU and the GPU 5% busy, against 166-269k on 32-thread Zen 3 / Zen 4 / Raptor Lake hosts (2026-10-20).
_harness_files_doc: The operator's files: at the start of every round orchestrator.py restores them from the main checkout's HEAD over the winner's head, so a branch cannot carry its own caps, grader or rules forward, and the operator's fixes reach every round. autoresearch/NOTES.md is NOT one of them: it is the lineage's memory and travels with the winner. tools/bad_hosts.json is merged instead (the union of every branch's list).
_lineage_keys_doc: Keys of this file that belong to the lineage, not the operator: when the winner changed one during its round, its value travels into the next round's config.json (r1b1 made its scratch recipe the incumbent_recipe on 2026-10-20). Everything else here is restored from the operator's HEAD.
_start_d_span_doc: score.py: the goalc_32 field at the map's ONE spawn point (-2176, -2272, 1192) reads 30,660 u; the player drops 4 u onto the start platform, where an episode's first row reads 30,647.5 (October's start_d). The 2% start test is taken outside this span. Grader only: nothing in training reads it.
_offer_query_doc: Scratch training here is CPU-bound: the trainer takes half the container's CPUs for physics. A 16-thread 3090 box ran the incumbent recipe at ~36k steps/s (2026-10-20, smoke_x1) against ~420k on the 5090 PC, so boxes need >= 32 effective threads on a fast CPU. Measured the same night on a 3090 + Ryzen 9 5950X box (32 threads, quota 30.7 CPUs, omp 15): ~194k steps/s, GPU 30% busy. gpu_ram>=12 (GB; 2026-10-25): the cheaper cards' 8 GB variants are out, every good card has 16-24 GB.

ONE token differs from the blue200, cannonball and petrus runs: --maxvel 3500 instead of 4000. That is the game server's physics for this map, not a recipe constant: the map's record was set under sv_maxvelocity 3500 (airaccelerate 100, gravity 800 = the core's defaults), October's unitfarmer2 program ran 3500, and the princessburglar arms of this program ran their server's 3500 the same way. Every other token is sidistic's. Launch: box.py launch --agent m6sib --run m6sib_uf2 --steps 60e9 -- --auto-spine-mcts-args '<the string above>'.
